Condition of L1 Evaluation and Award of Contract Quotation of unit rates. The Bidder shall quote a separate unit rate for each applicable line item in the B OQ, using the unit of measurement or pack size specified for that item. The reference quantity of 1 is for pr ice comparison. Actual order quantities shall be based on the Buyer’s requirements. Overall and item-wise L1 evaluation. The Buyer shall compare the total evaluated BOQ prices of techn ically responsive bidders to determine the Overall L1 and compare their quoted unit rates for each line ite m to determine the Item-wise L1. Award to one or more bidders. The Buyer may award the entire BOQ to the Overall L1 bidder or award i ndividual line items to their respective Item-wise L1 bidders. Where the Overall L1 bidder’s rate for a partic ular item is higher than the Item-wise L1 rate and the Buyer determines that the price difference is not justi fied, the Buyer may award that item to the Item-wise L1 bidder. The Buyer shall record its reasons for any split award. Applicable award method. Any item-wise or split award shall be subject to the evaluation and award m ethod disclosed in the tender, the applicable GeM bid and terms, and the applicable Gujarat procurement p olicy. .
